description: Store credentials for a third-party service in the tenant's vault. Secret fields (password, api_token, token, access_token, api_key, client_secret, secret, …) go into Supabase Vault and are addressed by id — they are NEVER written to a plain column and NEVER returned by any tool. Everything else (base_url, username, account ids) stays as readable configuration. Required: provider (a stable lower-case handle like 'placetel'), credentials (object). Optional display_name, status, replace. Storing again MERGES: config fields you do not send keep their current value, so changing one field does not silently drop the others (pass replace: true to deliberately clear them). Use this instead of putting a password into an AI memory item — a memory is loaded into prompts, a vault entry is not. NOTE: this tool cannot verify that the credentials actually work; unlike the service-specific connect tools it stores what it is given. Where a check matters, test the login separately and set status accordingly.

credentials.description: Flat object. Secret-typed keys are vaulted, the rest stays as config. Fields you do not send keep their current value.

display_name.description: Readable name for the integrations screen.

provider.description: Stable handle, lower case, e.g. 'placetel'. One row per tenant and provider; storing again MERGES into it.

replace.description: Drop every config field you did not send, instead of keeping it. Default false. Only for deliberately clearing an integration — a normal edit does not need it.

scope.description: tenant (default) = company integration, only admins or whoever may manage it. private = only for me: nobody else (admins included) can use it; my own private integration is used before the company one.

name: set_integration_credentials
